covers: The 8253 and 8254 programmable interval timer as a chip

left_out.why: one counter inside the chip, not a chip of its own
a type of pit8253: it adds the read-back command, which the 8253 type ignores
a different chip whose overrides were not read

entries.name: 8253 interval timer
entries.description: Programmable interval timer: three independent 16-bit down counters, each with its own mode, clock input, gate and output, behind one interface of four registers.
entries.behaviour: The low two address bits select counter 0, 1 or 2, or the control word. The 8254 adds a read-back command that the 8253 lacks.

sources.cites: These three functional blocks are identical in opera-
